title: Safe file reading
description:
Read numbers from a file and handle every kind of failure.

```
numbers.txt: 6 numbers, total 81, 1 bad line (line 4: "ten")
missing.txt: file not found
```
hints: `int.TryParse` decides whether a line is bad without throwing; keep the line number with a counter (lesson 4.03).
Put the whole loop in `try`, with `catch (FileNotFoundException) { return $"{path}: file not found"; }`.
requirements: `Summarise(string path)` returns a report string. Use `File.ReadLines`.
Catch `FileNotFoundException` and `UnauthorizedAccessException` separately; let other exceptions through.
Bad lines are counted and the first one is quoted, but do not stop the reading.
Create `numbers.txt` at the start of the program with `File.WriteAllLines`.
stretch: Write a custom `DataFileException` with the line number, and throw it when more than half the lines are bad.
